headers: theorem object_transport (P : ProjectiveLineOverC) (e : ProjectiveLine ≅ ProjectiveLine) (he : e.hom ≫ P.structureMap = P.structureMap) {n : ℕ} (X : ContactFanoManifold n) (f g : RationalCurve P X.variety) (hg : g.map = e.hom ≫ f.map) (hk : curveSquareMap P (curve P e he) ≫ curveSquareMap P f = curveSquareMap P g) {E F : OModule X.variety.scheme} (a : AlgebraicSection (pullbackModule f.map E)) (b : AlgebraicSection (pullbackModule f.map F)) : pullSection (curveSquareMap P (curve P e he)) (externalProductSection P.structureMap a b ≫ curveExternalComparison P f E F) ≫ (compositionPullback (curveSquareMap P (curve P e he)) (curveSquareMap P f) (curveSquareMap P g) hk (externalTensor X.variety.structureMap E F)).hom = @pullSection (SelfProduct P.structureMap) (SelfProduct P.structureMap) (curveSquareMap P (curve P e he)) (pullbackModule (curveSquareMap P f) (externalTensor X.variety.structureMap E F)) (externalProductSection P.structureMap a b ≫ curveExternalComparison P f E F) ≫ (@compositionPullback (SelfProduct P.structureMap) (SelfProduct P.structureMap) (SelfProduct X.variety.structureMap) (curveSquareMap P (curve P e he)) (curveSquareMap P f) (curveSquareMap P g) hk (externalTensor X.variety.structureMap E F)).hom

theorem direct_product (P : ProjectiveLineOverC) (e : ProjectiveLine ≅ ProjectiveLine) (he : e.hom ≫ P.structureMap = P.structureMap) {n : ℕ} (X : ContactFanoManifold n) (f g : RationalCurve P X.variety) (hg : g.map = e.hom ≫ f.map) (hk : curveSquareMap P (curve P e he) ≫ curveSquareMap P f = curveSquareMap P g) {E F : OModule X.variety.scheme} (a : AlgebraicSection (pullbackModule f.map E)) (b : AlgebraicSection (pullbackModule f.map F)) : @pullSection (SelfProduct P.structureMap) (SelfProduct P.structureMap) (curveSquareMap P (curve P e he)) (pullbackModule (curveSquareMap P f) (externalTensor X.variety.structureMap E F)) (externalProductSection P.structureMap a b ≫ curveExternalComparison P f E F) ≫ (@compositionPullback (SelfProduct P.structureMap) (SelfProduct P.structureMap) (SelfProduct X.variety.structureMap) (curveSquareMap P (curve P e he)) (curveSquareMap P f) (curveSquareMap P g) hk (externalTensor X.variety.structureMap E F)).hom = externalProductSection P.structureMap (pullSection e.hom a ≫ (compositionPullback e.hom f.map g.map hg.symm E).hom) (pullSection e.hom b ≫ (compositionPullback e.hom f.map g.map hg.symm F).hom) ≫ curveExternalComparison P g E F

theorem map_product (P : ProjectiveLineOverC) (e : ProjectiveLine ≅ ProjectiveLine) (he : e.hom ≫ P.structureMap = P.structureMap) {n : ℕ} (X : ContactFanoManifold n) (f g : RationalCurve P X.variety) (hg : g.map = e.hom ≫ f.map) (hk : curveSquareMap P (curve P e he) ≫ curveSquareMap P f = curveSquareMap P g) {E F : OModule X.variety.scheme} (a : AlgebraicSection (pullbackModule f.map E)) (b : AlgebraicSection (pullbackModule f.map F)) : externalProductSection P.structureMap (pullSection e.hom a ≫ (compositionPullback e.hom f.map g.map hg.symm E).hom) (pullSection e.hom b ≫ (compositionPullback e.hom f.map g.map hg.symm F).hom) ≫ curveExternalComparison P g E F = (externalProductSection P.structureMap (pullSection e.hom a) (pullSection e.hom b) ≫ externalTensorMap P.structureMap (compositionPullback e.hom f.map g.map hg.symm E).hom (compositionPullback e.hom f.map g.map hg.symm F).hom) ≫ curveExternalComparison P g E F

theorem comparison (P : ProjectiveLineOverC) (e : ProjectiveLine ≅ ProjectiveLine) (he : e.hom ≫ P.structureMap = P.structureMap) {n : ℕ} (X : ContactFanoManifold n) (f g : RationalCurve P X.variety) (hg : g.map = e.hom ≫ f.map) (hk : curveSquareMap P (curve P e he) ≫ curveSquareMap P f = curveSquareMap P g) {E F : OModule X.variety.scheme} (a : AlgebraicSection (pullbackModule f.map E)) (b : AlgebraicSection (pullbackModule f.map F)) : pullSection (curveSquareMap P (curve P e he)) (externalProductSection P.structureMap a b ≫ curveExternalComparison P f E F) ≫ (compositionPullback (curveSquareMap P (curve P e he)) (curveSquareMap P f) (curveSquareMap P g) hk (externalTensor X.variety.structureMap E F)).hom = (externalProductSection P.structureMap (pullSection e.hom a) (pullSection e.hom b) ≫ externalTensorMap P.structureMap (compositionPullback e.hom f.map g.map hg.symm E).hom (compositionPullback e.hom f.map g.map hg.symm F).hom) ≫ curveExternalComparison P g E F
